headline: Wall Street stocks have their third worst week in 6 years, Chapo Isidro capture
summary: US equity markets had their third-worst week in six years, according to the El Economista headline. The same front page also covered the capture of Chapo Isidro.
why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index for large US companies, so its weekly performance reflects broad sentiment for US equities.
why_moved: The input reports only that the week was the third-worst in six years, without giving a cause.
original_headline: Las Bolsas de Wall Street tiene su tercera peor semana en 6 años,La captura de Chapo Isidro
